field_evidence: Official MHCLG Planning Data authoritative listed-building-outline 42150006 provides a closed nonzero-area MultiPolygon for Monks Hall Museum in Salford, source reference LBEC11, data entry 2025-08-21, and direct listed-building foreign key 1162896. Historic England NHLE 1162896 corroborates Grade II Former Monks Hall Museum, 42 Wellington Road, Eccles, first listed 24 February 1964. Statutory description explicitly establishes the building as a house then a museum, built circa 1840 with earlier seventeenth-century fabric; the record's 2016 amendment reported it vacant and awaiting redevelopment. Historical Museum use is supported, but continued operation as a museum or current building condition is not asserted. The source geometry is an authoritative building-specific listed-building outline, not a canonical cadastral parcel or parcel materialization.
